elements.name: small town along top of high green ridge
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs
small terraced fields on steep slopes
layers of mountains fading into blue haze

notes: Strong match overall, but the village sits on a hillside shelf off to the right rather than strung along a ridge-top in the centre, and the gold light is faint, so recentre the town on the ridge crest and warm the morning glow.
